experiment.factor_1: Reuse separately sealed completed six-hour ORIGINAL and IMPROVED_BG_FIXED; do not rerun or overwrite.
experiment.intervention: Only native QSNOW values; compute float64(alpha * float64(base QSNOW)) then cast to original native dtype. All other variables and all metadata identical to family baseline.
experiment.interpretation: Initial snow-hydrometeor sensitivity of total ground precipitation, not verification of surface snowfall. Direct native-state ablation; added/removed initial water is deliberate and no mass/energy conservation or initialization balance is claimed.
experiment.cpu_affinity: Disjoint eight-CPU sets per concurrent job, respecting available CPUs.

evaluation.operator: Same pinned six-hour RN1/WRF bilinear scoring operator as PR136
evaluation.controls: Use exact sealed PR136 arrays; map native family CONTROL to ORIGINAL and IMPROVED to IMPROVED_BG_FIXED.

selection.eligible_cases: Twelve new completed and identity-validated candidates plus the two factor-1 family baselines. CURRENT_HYDRO is contextual only, not a tunable candidate.
feasibility_constraints: CSI at lead 1 h and 5 mm >= reference
ranking_order: descending arithmetic mean of six threshold CSI values at lead 1 h (equal threshold weights)
outputs: full unfiltered ranking and feasibility failures for every case
selection.fallback: Keep existing IMPROVED_BG_FIXED if no eligible case outranks it; do not force a new winner.
selection.incomplete_or_failed_cases: Retain failure evidence and exclude from ranking; never substitute partial forecast scores as six-hour results.

limitations: Selection and evaluation use the same one event; optimistic selection bias, no independent validation or general skill claim.
Thresholds and spatial points are correlated; mean CSI is a predefined ranking heuristic, not a physical quantity or significance test.
Six-hour pooled error guardrails do not guarantee every lead or threshold improves.
Family comparisons include differing initialization and executable; alpha effects are isolated only within a fixed family.
Future producer-consistent balanced implementation and independent weather cases are required before operational recommendation.
